settings.instructions: Bridge to Meta's official Ads MCP at https://mcp.facebook.com/ads based on https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/ads-commerce/ads-ai-connectors/ads-mcp-server/ads-mcp-server-get-started. Start with list_meta_ads_tools and use the returned live tool names and JSON schemas; never invent tool names. call_meta_ads_tool forwards a JSON-RPC tools/call envelope. It may read or change real ads; call writes only after the user authorizes the exact change. Never publish, activate, change budgets, or delete just to test connectivity. Configure your Meta app's Create & manage ads with ads MCP server use case and OAuth app credentials. Required scopes ads_mcp_management ads_read ads_management catalog_management business_management pages_show_list instagram_basic. This wrapper has two bridge tools, not a native replica of Meta's tool catalogue. Tokens expire; reconnect when Meta requires it.

tools.name: list_meta_ads_tools
tools.description: Read Meta's official live MCP tool catalogue. Returns a JSON-RPC result containing tool names, schemas and annotations. Discover before calling. Does not modify ads.

tools.name: call_meta_ads_tool
tools.description: Call a tool discovered with list_meta_ads_tools on Meta's official Ads MCP. This may change real campaigns, spending, catalogs or ads. Use live schemas and obtain explicit authorization before any write; harmless reads only for connectivity tests. Omit arguments for tools with no inputs. Inspect upstream error and result.isError fields; an HTTP 200 may still contain an MCP error.

name.description: Exact upstream tool name from list_meta_ads_tools

arguments.description: Nonempty arguments object matching the live upstream schema. Omit entirely for tools with no arguments.

excluded.reason: Stored credentials are encrypted with a key unique to the site that saved them, so they cannot be restored elsewhere. Re-enter them after importing.
